semantic.justification: Original export-only equivalence compares rule values first, continuous-numbering policy and only one/nine Word levels. Level comparison checks actual character-style item sets, copies actual SwNumFormat values, clears names/registrations and compares remaining native fields before destroying both temporary client registrations. Actual DOCX paragraph dispatch consumes these functions. Full binary importer, complete numbering/root/part/filter and fixture/model/UI roundtrip remain unported or unqualified; no status or whole-format parity promotion follows from these owner tests.
